description: Verification policy for AEGIS runtime-reliability skill. Thresholds and rules consumed by scripts/verify.mjs.

event_loop_p99.description: Candidate event-loop p99 latency must be at most 25% of baseline p99.

health_success_rate.description: Health probe success rate must be >= 99% during load.

health_p99.description: Health probe p99 response time must be <= 100 ms.

target_p99.description: Candidate target endpoint p99 must be at most 50% of baseline p99.

target_error_rate.description: Target endpoint error rate must be <= 1%.

functional_zero_failures.description: Functional test failures must be exactly zero.
